title: Best Stores for Baby stuffs (furniture, strollers/pram, clothes, accesories...)
label: budget

posts.body:
Hi, 

My baby is due next Feb, and would like to start to do some shopping for preparing the baby room.

any advice for good baby store in Hong Kong?

I've already been in Bumps to Babe (in Central and Ap Lei Chau), Eugene (central and Kowloon Bay/Mega Box), MotherCare (MegaBox/LeeGarden2/Ocean Terminal) and 0-3 baby (Ocean Terminal/LeeGarden2).

Any other place you would recommend? 

Heard some great place in Tung chung and New Territories?

Thanks for your help.

posts.body: Would recommend Colors in Wanchai (personalized service and has custom furniture ordering service), Windsor House and Sogo (small section) in CWB, and WingOn/Jusco/Apita in Tai Koo Shing (sometimes you can find cheaper prices of same brands at these stores).

posts.body:
Having had to advise many new parents about setting up a nursery i found babycentral.com to offer the widest range of products. I think they have a very fast delivery service too which is great. Also, if you can't find a product they offer to source it for you.

Best of luck in February and beyond!
